entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that functions as a universal memory layer with support for multi-level User, Session, and Agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A long-term memory system that utilizes retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn over time. It supports over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud using Python and Node.js client libraries.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading architecture. This AGPL-3.0 context database achieves significant token reduction and task-completion gains by archiving sessions as editable Markdown files.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: An open-source platform that provides agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It builds searchable graphs from text, code, and conversations locally on a CPU without requiring LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that sustains sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It supports multi-modal extraction and byte-level deduplication with a 100% prompt-cache discount.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated agent brain that stores facts with provenance, allowing for explicit corrections and withdrawals of information. It provides a synthesis layer for cited answers and exposes memory to agents via MCP over Tailscale or local connections.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that serves as the upstream foundation for the Hermes-compatible honcho-self-hosted wrapper. It is implemented as a FastAPI server and integrates with MCP, Claude Code, and Cursor-compatible clients.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that treats memory as a git repository, utilizing a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM for sub-100ms performance. It features git-like version control for context trees and an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency AI memory system designed for Hermes Agents that operates with sub-millisecond speed using only Python and a single SQLite database. It includes episodic compression to manage storage growth and supports integrations with MCP and OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent vector search and structured facts. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specifically injected context during task execution.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that generates playbooks and local-model training artifacts from task runs to assist agents with complex objectives. It supports various LLM endpoints and provides entry points via CLI, MCP server, and Pi extensions.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent that uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from persistent message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes session history from 35 different coding agents to provide shared cross-tool memory without using models or external servers. It allows users to search months of past sessions by tracking file edits, command exit statuses, and specific session spans locally.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted backend for Hermes Agent to enable private, cross-session memory persistence. It includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet offers a local-first identity and memory layer that supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other clients, achieving a 97.6% answer accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur implements a shared memory layer that stores human-readable YAML engrams on local disk for multi-agent systems. It utilizes local-first retrieval, including BGE-small and optional rerankers, to provide context across agents like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It captures agent decisions and preferences from transcripts using a retrieval system that fuses BM25, vector search, and multi-graph traversal.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl is a file-based long-term memory system that utilizes a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema with FTS5 search instead of vector databases. It features a dedicated Hermes adapter and supports Linux, macOS, and Windows via WSL2.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes long-context LLM inference for Hermes Agent by reordering and deduplicating text and multimodal context. It integrates with vLLM and llama.cpp to provide cache-aware scheduling and prefix-cache sharing.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded in-process plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recall with a reason for its selection. It manages memory through canonicalization and recency ranking while surfacing contradictions via conflict and resolution primitives.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search to provide cross-project memory for coding agents.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI serves as a machine interface for agents to autonomously maintain persistent wiki pages, citations, and links across sessions. It supports portable memory archives, allowing agents to import and merge source-grounded knowledge.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate is an anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by watching agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace to provide purpose-built evidence packets to the Hermes agent. It manages state and retrieval using a stack consisting of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This project provides reflective memory using semantic search and ranked graph traversal to navigate bidirectional relationships between notes. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support, allowing agents to manage complex data through edge tags.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search integration.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: This Git-backed context layer facilitates a migration workflow that converts chats and documents into reviewable files for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It emphasizes manual oversight by requiring user review for all context proposals and integration enablement.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via importance-weighted recall. It combines BM25 keyword search with optional GLiNER2 entity extraction to manage named graph relationships between entries.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that implements real, immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It provides an audit trace of every memory operation via a trace.jsonl log and uses an on-demand summarizer.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle x402 payments and manage budget-bound wallets across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys, allowing agents to pay for services using USDC and stablecoins.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations to provide agents with local capability routing. It uses session hooks to deliver concise system-prompt hints and includes five native tools for artifact search and retrieval.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-agent continuity by allowing Hermes to read memories from other connected agents through a local SQLite caching layer. It integrates native lifecycle hooks for pre-turn recall and session-end snapshots to ensure durable cross-session memory.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and targeted search. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of stored information.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin offers private local code memory for repositories, supporting deterministic slash commands for searching, syncing, and reading files. It requires a local SourceVault server for indexing and provides LLM-callable tools for models with structured tool use.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, offering metadata filtering and MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This project provides 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve agent state.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop for agent memory that identifies stale information and contradictions within plain markdown files. It generates evidence-cited JSON diffs for manual review, utilizing a local git repository to track and revert changes to the memory state.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a software development methodology focused on TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It automates implementation planning and spec elicitation while supporting integration with various coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for Hermes Agent. It exports designs to formats including HTML, PDF, and MP4, utilizing the DeepSeek Harness for agent runtime support.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 818 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. The library covers 34 security domains and is compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the conversion of codebases, schemas, and IaC into draw.io diagrams using natural language. It features a CLI and MCP server that support incremental synchronization while preserving manual layout changes.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates and ERC-7710 delegated permissions. It integrates x402 payments and escrow services with a dedicated verification and dispute resolution layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Designed to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns, this tool audits and rewrites content for agents like Hermes and Claude Code. It offers specific modes for detection, rewriting, and editing text in place.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and quality improvement to unify libraries across teams and devices. It integrates with Hermes, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs to facilitate collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation folder to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,176 markdown-based professional skills across 35 different vocations. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring telemetry, runtimes, or mandatory user accounts.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This tool provides Hermes Agent with the ability to search YouTube, browse channels, and extract video transcripts or playlist data. It functions across multiple platforms including OpenClaw and Cursor using a TranscriptAPI key.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, managed via specialized slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes tools for reading bundled resources and executing scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically synchronizes edits between source code and the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough concepts into structured design and implementation documents through Lite or Full complexity modes. It ensures quality through a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models for project handoffs.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro coordinates agent teams using the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and a mechanism kernel for SQLite storage. It distributes prompt-first working methods as Markdown recipes and utilizes event logging to manage long-running tasks.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides a registry of Portuguese-language skills and guides for VPS deployment and MCP integration. Users can install these localized skills directly via a CLI tap or raw URLs.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Built on the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports integrations for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, with installation managed through the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX image and video generation. The suite includes eight specialist skills that support polling, webhooks, and FLUX 3 video workflows.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts code repositories and developer discourse into verified instruction files compliant with the agentskills.io spec. It maps instructions to specific source lines and includes automated workflows for briefing, testing, and exporting skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that uses a Rust binary to execute tasks across local and cloud models. It generates hash-chained records for tamper-evident verification and performs static audits of costs and permissions prior to execution.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills with a Python client and CLI that supports recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features, allowing for skill transactions using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time tracking of decisions. It includes built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer intelligent retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and is designed to degrade gracefully if embedding models are unavailable.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token consumption during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and schemas.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to allow Hermes Agent to manage habits, study blocks, and scheduling. It stores data locally in a single SQLite file and provides both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across multiple interfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this multi-agent skill simplifies code in languages such as Python, Rust, and Go using specialized Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition to ensure evidence-based verification during execution. It includes a Python-based goal engine for persistent state management and systematic causal debugging.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics, networking, and exploitation. It integrates 28 industry frameworks and standards, covering real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection of production-tested skills provides commands for session tracking, worktree recovery, and PR orchestration. The skills are delivered as drop-in markdown files and include a bundled installer for managing updates and drift checks.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent, tracking token costs, session history, and skill analytics. It ensures data privacy through read-only access and local log desensitization while offering optional incident alerting via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by generating vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It optimizes output files to stay under 8 MB and supports a variety of interfaces including CLIs, TUIs, and web applications.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify skill gaps and proposing structured updates. It gates these improvements behind a local evaluation framework using deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators to prevent regressions.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files while preventing specification rot. It includes a validator that monitors official frontmatter changes weekly to detect field drift and ensure CI-friendly compliance.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage provides agents with skills for social data enrichment, CRM management, and lead generation. It includes an MCP server for browser-based OAuth authentication and is compatible with agentskills.io compliant clients.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized tools for video transcription, OCR, and content refinement, such as converting Douyin videos to Markdown. It utilizes a rule-based engine to remove common AI writing patterns and macOS Vision for structured data extraction.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures compatibility by verifying existing project runtimes and using environment-specific syntax.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses across multiple protocols including x402 and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent standards.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, security, and functionality within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to confirm that a skill operates as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn or distribute USDC on the Base network by solving support bounties over x402. It operates without accounts or API keys, facilitating payments to wallets once a human approves the winning answer.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project grants Hermes Agent access to structured web data across 31 platforms via an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills and supports multiple AI clients including Claude and Cursor.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and applies quality gates to produce structured analysis featuring core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework decomposes financial trading into specialized analyst, researcher, and trader roles for targeted task execution. It integrates data from SEC EDGAR, FRED, and social sentiment sources, utilizing a portfolio manager to provide final approval or rejection for all transactions.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and memory browsing while tracking operational costs. It supports local Node.js or Docker deployment and offers multiple interfaces including a Web UI, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities. It ensures persistent execution via tmux and provides sandboxing options through Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams, this template utilizes a level-based architecture. It employs a task bus pattern for orchestrator-to-specialist delegation and includes bundled skills for security auditing and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms across 23+ LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts to manage agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live reasoning streams. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification by requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure roles using a strict pipeline architecture. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of tasks throughout the entire system.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the Hermes Kanban. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for tool handling and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for execution and learning, visualized through a real-time task and scoreboard dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama. It leverages Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, specifically optimized for consumer RTX 4080 and 5080 hardware.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered knowledge graph that pre-indexes codebases to minimize token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It automatically configures as an MCP server and maintains background synchronization to ensure Hermes Agent has immediate access to project context.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI utility tracks token consumption across various AI coding tools and provides a terminal-based UI alongside a 3D visualization dashboard. It allows Hermes Agent users to monitor their usage data and participate in public leaderboards or profiles.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting sensitive authentication headers. It exports session data into self-contained HTML viewers, facilitating the debugging of agent communications.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget monitors real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLI tools directly. It synchronizes data across multiple machines to provide historical breakdowns by project, device, and specific tool.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other markdown-supporting providers to streamline the UI development process.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer extends Hermes Agent by loading 36 skills and six specialized workflows into the environment. It utilizes a CTO loop to coordinate seven agent roles for automated deployment, health monitoring, and log observation.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This customization tool allows users to modify the Hermes terminal UI with custom banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. It uses YAML-based configurations to apply diverse visual themes ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is designed for autonomous agent control and supports external MCP clients for browser automation. It features a supervisor sidebar that allows users to manage agent checkpoints, approvals, and conversation threads.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and identity registration with human-readable handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter validates AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts against HERM v1.1 scoring standards. It identifies schema mismatches and contradictory directions in JSON, YAML, and Markdown, exporting results in formats like SARIF and GitLab Code Quality.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides memory systems for various frameworks using a two-tier architecture of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms and coding environments, offering persistent memory capabilities for agent-based workflows.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, supported by an automated cross-platform installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for project-local memories, tools, and instructions. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents based on the local configuration of the directory.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides an automated installation path for the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It enables zero-cost operations using free models and supports 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions users from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the conversion of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It detects performance drift using config-aware baselines and supports both zero-token passive analysis and active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local runtime by default, this project focuses on deterministic operations that require explicit approval for external writes and consequential actions. It includes specific contracts for managing opportunities and offer-previews to help users generate value through the agent.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds a fully local, voice-enabled interface to Hermes Agent featuring wake-word activation and adaptive turn-taking. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, operating entirely offline without the need for API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for managing agent information. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages while providing tools to search, add, and delete memory entries.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager supports Windows, macOS, and Linux for handling Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI. It streamlines the user experience by enabling one-click switching between different API providers and managing their respective configurations.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that facilitates autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access for Hermes Agent and other CLIs. It features built-in assistants for generating editable office documents and supports 24/7 unattended automation via cron and remote access.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web interface provides 1:1 parity with Hermes CLI features for use on web browsers and mobile devices. Built with Python and vanilla JS, it utilizes a three-panel layout to organize chat, sessions, and workspace browsing.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app offers guided installation with dependency resolution for Hermes Agent across multiple AI providers like OpenAI and Anthropic. The GUI includes dedicated modules for chat, session management, memory, and tool configuration.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a web dashboard that manages Hermes Agent sessions, scheduled jobs, and usage analytics across ten platforms including Telegram and Discord. It supports visual workflows that incorporate schedules and human approval gates for task execution.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex operations. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser and PTY terminal alongside a memory browser and MCP catalog.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and fourteen other built-in agents as a desktop or self-hosted app. It offers native iOS and Android clients for remote access and supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for real-time session data. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop app features a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat and memory management tasks.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser tabs to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes for site-aware drafting. It features multi-agent switching and opt-in browser control with session-synced chat histories.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app designed to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent via a hermes-webui server. It provides mobile management for server file systems and tasks, featuring real-time chat streaming with tool-call and thinking details.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency while providing a live view for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It includes a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that allows users to search prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across local agent histories. It builds a local search index to track per-session token burn and estimated API costs without uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically features an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports managing profiles, skills, and toolsets while providing a kanban board for agentic work and task management.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a 10-page mobile-first UI with terminal chat and file attachment support. It utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to support background spawning of up to five concurrent agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring installation or admin rights. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, supported by a built-in workflow engine for multi-step pipelines.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and chat for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes an integrated file browser, task tracking dashboard, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, offering real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards within a chat-first interface. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
